svg.title: Stationary solver loop with carried states
svg.desc: The operator, right-hand side, and a stopping contract enter a loop body that is captured once. Four states (solution u, residual r, search direction p, and the residual inner product rho) are carried from each iteration to the next. The loop repeats a fixed number of times or stops when the residual norm reaches the tolerance, and returns u.
svg.text: Stationary solvers: one captured loop, carried states
carried states u, r, p, rho — repeat k times, or while ||r|| > tol, bounded by max_iterations
